figurative_meaning_bn: কোন বিষয় বা বস্তু কোনকালেই আকার পরিবর্তন না করলে তাকে কদম্বগোলকন্যায় বলে
figurative_meaning_en: Referring to something that never changes its shape or form at any time, just like Kadamba flowers which are born and grow uniformly in a spherical shape
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মতামত কদম্বগোলকন্যায়, কখনো পরিবর্তন হয় না।
এই নিয়ম কদম্বগোলকন্যায়, সবাইকে মেনে চলতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: His opinion is like kadambagolakanyay, it never changes.
This rule is like kadambagolakanyay, everyone must follow it without alteration.
history: The idiom draws from the observation of Kadamba flowers (from the Kadamba tree, common in Bengal), which bloom in uniform spherical clusters without changing shape, symbolizing permanence in Bengali folklore and poetry.
note: The idiom highlights uniformity and immutability inspired by natural phenomena in Bengali rural life.
